older_mercury_evidence.consequence: The current 10-bit DS save encoding cannot represent the complete older Mercury namespace.

recovery_rules: Newest explicit Mercury redesign/approval wins over older donor semantics.
Do not resurrect superseded abilities or old mechanics such as retired versions of Foamy Web.
All official current Generation 3-9 abilities must exist exactly once.
Donor/library abilities are deduplicated by identity and mechanics, not blindly summed by source.
Mercury originals and signature abilities are preserved.
Deep Pockets and Predator's Edge are included as new Mercury abilities.
Do not renumber or migrate live ability IDs until the full collision/rewrite map and persistent-save width migration are audited.
required_next_steps: Build full canonical current-generation name set and compare against DS generated namespace.
Overlay all later Mercury redesign decisions and mark KEEP/RESTORE/SUPERSEDED/ALIAS.
Design and certify 11-bit-or-wider persistent ability storage for DS.
Create deterministic ID migration/remap before changing the custom namespace.
Re-run native compile, ROM build, Primary/Innate routing, and assignment audits.
